mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 6.5% within the past 3 months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 6.5% in 3 months, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate a contraction in consumer demand, reducing corporate revenue expectations and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a supply-driven slowdown (INDPRO < 100 and UNRATE > 6.0%), industrial output contraction and labor market weakness reduce corporate profitability, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO < 100 and UNRATE > 6.0%, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real retail sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer spending, boosting corporate revenues and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when RSAFS increases, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPI inflation rate above 2.5% signals persistent inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, increasing discount rates and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 2.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a labor market recovery (UNRATE < 6.0% and PAYEMS > 100000), employment growth supports consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE < 6.0% and PAYEMS > 100000, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 for two consecutive months signals manufacturing slowdown, reducing corporate output and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO < 100 for 2 consecutive months, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.
